stem.en: A reflected sound reaches your ear 0.04 s after the original sound. Is it an echo or reverberation?

text.en: An echo, because the sound has been reflected.
Reverberation, because 0.04 s is less than 0.1 s, so it cannot be heard as a separate sound.
An echo, because 0.04 s is long enough to hear two sounds.
Neither, because reflected sound cannot be heard.

explanation.en: An echo is heard only if the reflection reaches you at least 0.1 s after the original sound. 0.04 s is much less, so the reflection mixes with the sound and makes it last longer: this is reverberation.

hints.en: What is the shortest gap for an echo?
